name: Lifelog
summary: Capture everything the user sees and hears (screen snapshots, OCR text, audio transcripts) and make it searchable, so an agent can answer questions about past activity. Most implementations store data locally and expose it through search or an MCP server.
how: Snapshot the screen every few seconds or on window change
Extract text with the accessibility tree or OCR, and transcribe audio
Index the result locally with timestamps
Expose search and a timeline to the user and to agents (for example via MCP)
Filter sensitive apps, sites and fields before storing
facts: Local snapshots plus a text index
Windows Recall needs at least 50 GB free
Complete recall, but large privacy surface and storage cost
goodFor: Answering "what was I looking at last week?"
Personal assistants that need ambient context
watchOut: Captures passwords, messages and other people's data unless filtered
Raw capture is noisy; needs extraction before an agent can use it
Screenpipe is source-available, not open source
